On The 8 th Of March, 2025
 Misc. Criminal Case No. 4744 of 2020
 Manoj Kushwaha
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh
 Appearance:
 Parties through their counsel.

Order 
Applicant has filed this petition being aggrieved of the order dated 19-12- 2019 of Crime No.
38/2018 registered at police station Baikunthpur Dist- Rewa whereby offence under Sections 454,
450, 376(2), 506-II of IPC and under Section 6 of POCSO Act, 2012 have been levelled against the applicant.
It is pointed out that during the pendency of the present petition, Crime No. 38/2018 has finally been decided on 08-09-2021 by the learned trial Court, wherein the applicant have been acquitted.
Therefore, nothing survives for adjudication in the present petition.
Accordingly, this petition is disposed of having rendered infructuous.
